items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: I know he was here, because I worked 25 with him in Lewis plays. Uh huh. With Bischie.

ctx.x: Pils? Well, it wasn't much to Pils. Wasn't much to Pils. Now I'll tell you a fella, I don't know about, I didn't hear him here, but he fun, you have to tell me, but he played a lot of clarinet. That was this B-guard, where he was Duke. Now I'll tell you who I played with here before he left a little bit, Sidney Bischie, but not much, because he left as soon as I come in the hall and he left. He left right after Lewis, you tell me.
He must have left before Lewis, because you played with Lewis down here.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
